newsitem.title: USA: LaserVision to add surgery sites soon.
newsitem.headline: LaserVision to add surgery sites soon.

text.p: LaserVision Centers Inc said Wednesday it is preparing to open up to 40 new excimer laser surgery sites in the coming months.

In comments presented at the company's annual shareholder meeting, LaserVision chairman and chief executive John Klobnak said the company will install its MobilExcimer system at the new locations being developed with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp.
LaserVision operates excimer lasers used in eye surgery.
Its shares closed down 1/16 Wednesday at 5-3/8.
